mods.name: Tim (Trail Investigator Module)
mods.description: A Meteor Client addon built with AI featuring a handful of utilities for hunting.

releases.notes:
Tim 1.2 (Trail Investigator Module) is a comprehensive multi-version Meteor Client utility and base-hunting addon fully compatible across Minecraft 1.21.4 to 1.21.11. + 26.1.

- Manuscript
Fill books with text, Unicode patterns, ASCII banners, or UTF-8 files. Set page limits, colors, formatting, and text scaling. Fill automatically or manually, with an optional title.

- Illumood
Choose Normal, Half-Bright, or Fullbright, with optional cave boost below Y=48. Customize grass, foliage, water, sky, and fog colors.

- Waypearl
Detect stasis pearls and request pulls from a whitelisted assistant through the encrypted local messenger, including when you join. After a confirmed pull, the assistant can drop a replacement and remind you to place it. A customizable HUD displays updates.

- Illushine & Mobanom
Illushine highlights misrotated deepslate, with configurable range and color. Mobanom tracks Overworld endermites, with configurable color and an optional beam.

- Tweaker
Move in inventories, keep them open in portals, reach containers through obstacles, and place blocks in mid-air.
Safe Walker sneaks near edges; Attack Guard blocks selected mob attacks.
Elytra Takeoff jumps, glides, and uses a rocket.
Surface Path and Ender Chest Path use Baritone, with independent controls and optional terrain changes.
Surface Path works in the Overworld; Ender Chest Path also works in the Nether and End. Overworld water recovery is available; Baritone outlines are hidden.

- Rocket Pilot
Auto-takeoff now jumps, releases, glides, and uses a rocket. Ebounce keeps its separate launch behavior.

- Safety Net
Attempts a 5×5 air-place platform using a chosen hotbar slot. Damage disconnect is on by default alongside the Y-level disconnect.

- Loot Lens
Ignores empty shulkers in opened containers by default. Filled shulkers and configured custom items can still trigger highlights.

Safety note: Movement, takeoff, pathing, and rescue are not guaranteed safe. Other modules, servers, and the environment can affect results. Test in a safe area first.
